summary:
Citadel (Rubner) dominates this window with 8 flow notes: a rotational-not-disorderly drawdown under the index, Mag 7 as the only group in the black since Sept 1, thinning breadth beneath concentrated leadership, retail disengaging (not capitulating) from AI names, and the approaching 'best buy-point' of the 4-year election cycle. Citi contributed 2 notes making the case that a 5% 10yr yield hasn't historically killed equity returns, even as inflation breadth stays elevated. Apollo/Slok (Torsten Slok) flagged a structural copper squeeze building from a multi-decade drought in new discoveries against AI-driven demand growth.

Counts: Citadel 8, Citi 2, Apollo/Slok 1.

items.author: MikeZaccardi
items.text:
Major copper discoveries have plummeted to zero, yet AI data centers are surging in a 2-3-year cycle.

Since mines take ~18 years to build, today’s drought is tomorrow's supply crunch in the 2040s. Structural squeeze incoming. 📉⚡️📈 Torsten at Apollo https://t.co/Wu6txMRXB9
